title: Highway Billboard Leasing
brief: A media company owns a row of billboard sites along a highway, each with a known monthly lease offer. A zoning rule forbids leasing two sites that stand directly next to each other.
Implement bestLeaseRevenue(nums), where nums holds the offer for each site in order along the highway, and return the largest total revenue achievable while obeying the rule.
